description: Export people (entity=contacts) or organisations (entity=accounts) as a real spreadsheet file and return { url, filename, format, count, columns, hidden_columns, truncated }. url is a signed link (7 days) to a private file. format: xlsx (default) | csv (semicolon-separated, UTF-8 with BOM so Excel opens umlauts correctly). Optional filters: ids (export exactly these rows, e.g. the current filtered list), label, filter or saved_filter_id (as in search_crm), search (name/e-mail/phone/city), owner_id, max_rows (default 5000, max 20000). Fields hidden from your role by field permissions are LEFT OUT of the file (listed in hidden_columns), and search only looks at visible fields. xlsx adds a second sheet 'Verlauf' (messages, calls, meetings, e-mails of the exported people; for organisations of their people and leads) unless include_history=false. Needs admin or the role permission contacts:export / accounts:export; every export is written to audit_log (action export) and the tool can be locked per person via permission sets.

filter.description: Combinable filter like search_crm: { all: [...], any: [...] }.

include_history.description: xlsx only: add the sheet Verlauf (default true).

label.description: Only records with this label (name or id).

name: export_crm_file
